hooks.name: player_kicked
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerKickEvent)

rust_summary: A guest was disconnected by a server kick (`native_player_kicked`).
doc_summary: A guest was kicked from the server: `native_player_kicked(player, name, reason)` is called after the hub records the rendered reason and sends the disconnect. The guest's state is swapped in. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_kicked@.
